name: Red Faction
description: Red Faction is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter game and the first in the Red Faction series.

steam.patches: Dash Faction fixes many of Red Faction's bugs and adds widescreen support. It also positions sounds itself, so they move between left and right with EAX on (per a bug report on GitHub). Its installer swaps in the 1.20 North American RF.exe it needs.

gog.patches: Dash Faction fixes many of Red Faction's bugs and adds widescreen support. It also positions sounds itself, so they move between left and right with EAX on (per a bug report on GitHub). Its installer swaps in the 1.20 North American RF.exe it needs.

eax.problem: With EAX on, every sound in Red Faction plays from straight ahead, so you hear the reverb but nothing moves between left and right. The game sets each sound's left/right balance itself, and the restored EAX sound ignores it for now (per a bug report on GitHub).
